title: Thai-Style Turkey Sliders with Peanut Sauce
changes_from_base: Turkey replaces beef, mixed with spring onion, coriander, chilli-garlic sauce, lime zest and a little melted butter; the thin patties are pan-fried and topped with a fish sauce and lime peanut sauce and a sweet-sour cucumber salad.
summary: These fragrant sliders draw on Thai flavours with minced turkey enriched by coriander and lime, finished with a silky peanut sauce and tangy cucumber.
equipment: zip-top freezer bag, sides cut open
clear glass pie dish or flat plate

ingredients.item: turkey mince (about 7% fat, not extra-lean breast)
fine sea salt or table salt
slider buns, split and toasted if you like

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Whisk together 65 g smooth peanut butter, 4 tsp fish sauce, 1 tbsp light brown sugar and 3 tbsp lime juice until smooth, loosening with a little water to ketchup thickness.

steps.title: Slaw
steps.text: Mix ½ sliced cucumber, ½ sliced red onion, 2 tsp fish sauce, 2 tsp light brown sugar and 2 tbsp lime juice in a small bowl.

steps.title: Meat
steps.text: Break up 680 g turkey mince and knead in 4 chopped spring onions, 4 tbsp chopped fresh coriander, 30 g melted and cooled unsalted butter, 1 tbsp chilli-garlic sauce and 1 tsp finely grated lime zest.

steps.title: Form
steps.text: Shape the mixture into 12 balls of about 57 g, place each inside an opened zip-top freezer bag and press with a pie dish into a 10 cm patty; chill on a tray.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Season the patties all over with ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp ground black pepper in total.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Heat 1 tsp vegetable oil in a large non-stick frying pan over medium until just smoking, cook 6 patties for 2-3 min per side until well browned and the centre reaches 74 °C on an instant-read thermometer; place on bun bottoms and cover with foil.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Wipe the pan and repeat with the remaining 1 tsp oil and patties.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Top each slider with the peanut sauce, cucumber salad and bun top, then serve straight away.

tips: Loosen the peanut sauce with water a little at a time until it is as thick as ketchup; it contains peanuts and fish sauce
Use a pie dish to press the patties evenly through the freezer-bag method
safety: Verify the turkey reaches 74 °C in the thickest part using an instant-read thermometer
storage: These sliders are best served fresh, straight from the pan. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
